# KoyJabo (কই যাবো)

> KoyJabo is Bangladesh's premier multimodal public transport guide and real-time routing platform, covering 460+ Dhaka city buses, 255 intercity trains across 440+ stations, MRT Line-6 Metro Rail, nationwide intercity bus operators, river launches, domestic flights, and nationwide freight truck services.

## Core Services & Guides
- [Local Bus Hub](https://koyjabo.com/local-bus.md): Complete list of 466+ Dhaka city bus routes, stops, and schedules.
- [Metro Rail MRT-6 Guide](https://koyjabo.com/metro.md): Complete guide to Dhaka Metro Rail (MRT Line-6) stations, timings, single journey tokens, and Rapid Pass discounts.
- [Bangladesh Railway Guide](https://koyjabo.com/train.md): Intercity train schedules, routes, seat classes, and live tracking across 440+ stations.
- [Intercity Bus Operators](https://koyjabo.com/intercity.md): Nationwide long-distance bus operators, counter phone numbers, routes, and fares.
- [Freight Truck & Cargo](https://koyjabo.com/truck.md): Nationwide 7-ton to 15-ton truck and covered van hire rates and booking hotline.
- [Bangladesh Travel & Tourism](https://koyjabo.com/discover.md): Transport travel guides and transit options for top tourist destinations.
- [Transit Fare Calculator](https://koyjabo.com/fare.md): Government-approved fare calculators for buses, trains, and metro.

## Research & Empirical Transit Datasets
- [Transport Research Hub](https://koyjabo.com/research.md): Empirical studies, statistics, and citeable transport datasets.
- [Dhaka Bus Transit Statistics 2026](https://koyjabo.com/research/dhaka-bus-statistics.md): Statistical analysis of 200+ bus services and 2,400+ stops in Dhaka.
- [Bangladesh Railway Statistics 2026](https://koyjabo.com/research/bangladesh-railway-statistics.md): Station distribution across 8 divisions and intercity fleet schedules.
- [Dhaka Metro Rail MRT-6 Benchmark 2026](https://koyjabo.com/research/dhaka-metro-rail-data.md): Operational metrics, 17 stations, 32-minute traversal, and Rapid Pass savings.

## Machine-Readable API
- [Markdown API Catalog](https://koyjabo.com/api/md/_catalog.json): Complete catalog of all AI-readable markdown files with byte sizes and content hashes.
